description: This is a Linux kernel driver source file for the RV5C386A Real Time Clock (RTC) used in WL-HDD devices. It includes functions for reading and setting the RTC time via I2C, handling device open/close, and platform detection.

methods.name: rtc_open
methods.description: Handles opening the RTC device, initializes I2C and platform detection.

methods.name: rtc_read
methods.description: Reads current RTC time and outputs it in a specific string format.

methods.name: rtc_write
methods.description: Sets RTC time based on input string in format 'YYYY:MM:DD:W:HH:MM:SS\n'.

methods.name: rtc_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for reading and setting RTC time.

methods.name: get_rtc_time
methods.description: Reads time from RTC hardware via I2C.

methods.name: set_rtc_time
methods.description: Writes time to RTC hardware via I2C.

methods.name: platform_detect
methods.description: Detects platform-specific GPIO configuration for RTC communication.

methods.name: rtc_init
methods.description: Initializes the RTC driver, sets platform, and switches RTC to 24h mode.

methods.name: rtc_exit
methods.description: Cleans up the driver on module removal.
